historical_binding_policy: Retain each v0.3.8 component at its original version and original model compatibility. Preserve changed delivery-tool bodies under versioned retained aliases. Do not relabel historical SQL, cohort, evaluation or manuscript results as 0.3.2 evidence.
namespace_policy: Keep established term IRIs; use a distinct 0.3.2 ontology versionIRI and exact source digest. No universal organizational approval requirement is introduced.
publication_policy: R1 selects and qualifies; R2 packages, publishes and performs maintained-channel readback. No live/default promotion or issue closure in R1.
